get.summary: Check an invitation link before the activation form.
get.description:
`email` is the address the inviter suggested, if any: the form pre-fills it and the
invitee may change it.

post.summary: Create an account from an invitation link.
post.description:
The invitee chooses the address and the display name; the role and the tenant come
from the link. The account starts without a second factor. `mfa_setup` carries what
the next step needs, valid fifteen minutes: a TOTP secret and its QR code for
`/mfa/verify-setup`, and a setup token that `/passkey/setup/begin` accepts as well.

post.summary: Enable TOTP at activation with a first code of the secret, and sign in.
Start registering a passkey at activation, in place of TOTP.
Register the activation passkey, and sign in; the challenge names the account.
Sign in with email and password.
post.description:
Opens the session when the account has no second factor. With TOTP enabled,
returns an `mfa_token` instead, to finish with `/mfa/verify`. An account
protected by a passkey only signs in with `/passkey/login/*`.

post.summary: Finish a sign-in with the authenticator-app code.
post.description: The `mfa_token` from `/login` works once, within ten minutes.

post.summary: Start a passwordless sign-in.
post.description:
The options allow any passkey registered for this site: the one the user picks
identifies the account.

post.summary: Finish a passwordless sign-in.

get.summary: Check a password-reset link, and tell which second factor the reset asks for.

post.summary: Reset a password with a reset link and a TOTP code.
post.description:
Consumes the link and ends every session. An account without TOTP resets with
its passkey, through `/passkey/reset-password/*`.

post.summary: Start a password reset confirmed by passkey.
Finish a password reset confirmed by passkey; consumes the link and ends every session.
Renew the access token of the session.
post.description:
Authenticated by the refresh token. The new access token is never confirmed:
only presenting a second factor confirms a session.

post.summary: Sign out.
post.description:
Authenticated by the refresh token, which is revoked with every access token issued
from it.

post.summary: Hand the session over to another device.
post.description:
Asks an account that has a second factor for a confirmed session. Returns a
single-use token, valid five minutes, that `/session-transfer/validate` exchanges
for a session on the other device, confirmed until the same time as this one.
Signing out of this session ends the token with it.

post.summary: Open a session from a transfer token.
post.description:
The session inherits what is left of the confirmation of the one that handed it
over: the receiving device has no second factor of its own to confirm with yet.

post.summary: Confirm identity with the password and the TOTP code.
post.description:
Replaces the access cookie with one that opens the routes asking for a
confirmed session, for ten minutes. A confirmation always attests a second
factor: an account without TOTP confirms through `/step-up/passkey/*`.

post.summary: Start confirming identity with a passkey.
Finish confirming identity with a passkey; the same session as `/step-up/password`.

get.summary: Full dietary tag and certification catalog.
get.description:
No authentication required. Returns all tag categories (with their tags)
and certification categories (with SVG logos), sorted by `sort_order`.

Used by the frontend to:
- Display labels, icons and colors
- Render SVG logos for certifications
- Populate selectors in the admin interface

A new address ends every other session and opens a new one for the caller,
which is not confirmed; the previous address is told by email. An account
changes address twice a day at most.

post.summary: Register the passkey the browser created from the options; guarded like them.
Options to create a passkey with, and the challenge to send back.
post.description:
From a confirmed session once the account has a second factor; its first is
enrolled freely. The options leave out the passkeys already registered, and ask
for one that serves passwordless sign-in. `this_device` asks for this device's
own authenticator.

delete.summary: Remove a passkey, from a confirmed session; never the last while TOTP is off.

post.summary: Check the current password, then challenge the account's passkeys.
post.description: For an account that changes its password with a passkey rather than a code.

put.summary: Change the password, and end every session, this one included.
put.description:
With the current password and a TOTP code, or, for an account protected by a
passkey only, with the passkey challenged by `POST /v1/user/password/options`.

post.summary: A new secret to scan, for enabling TOTP or moving it to another device.
post.description:
From a confirmed session once the account has a second factor. Nothing is
stored: the secret travels in `enrolment_token` until `PUT /v1/user/totp`
checks a first code, and the TOTP in use keeps working until then.

put.summary: Store the secret of an enrolment once its first code is checked.
put.description:
Guarded like the enrolment. Enables TOTP, or replaces the secret in use; a
wrong code can be tried again with the same `enrolment_token`.

delete.summary: Turn TOTP off, from a confirmed session; never while it is the only factor.

post.summary: Stop the weekly email of the account the email's token names.
post.description:

of the page the email's own link opens.

post.summary: Count one view of a public page.
post.description:
Body: `page_kind` (`today`, `tomorrow`, `day`, `tv` or `sites`), plus `site`, the
slug of the site a page belongs to. Read whatever the content type, which
`navigator.sendBeacon` sets to text/plain to avoid a CORS preflight.

Always answers 204, even when telemetry is off or the body is wrong: a
visitor must never see a page degraded by a counter.
